To breed a Shugabeats in My Singing Monsters, you need to first obtain a Shugabush monster from the Shugabush Island. Then, hatch the eggs obtained and purchase the breeding structure. Finally, use a Shugabush and a Furcorn in the breeding structure to create a Shugabeats monster.
</answer>
